name: On-delay normally-closed contact
summary: An on-delay NC contact opens after the associated timing condition has persisted for its documented interval.
description: An on-delay NC contact opens after the associated timing condition has persisted for its documented interval. Its unoperated closed state is read separately from the timing annotation.
readingNotes: Trace what happens to the downstream permissive while the delay is running.
The preview is an original explanation of this function. Match the actual drawing convention to its legend and the selected equipment documentation.
distinction: An on-delay NC contact is not an off-delay NO contact even if a sequence produces similar output timing.
